summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a judicial settlement reached on July 17, 2026, in a shareholder derivative lawsuit. The settlement requires the defendants to pay JPY 20,000,000 (~USD 122,000) to the plaintiffs, with payment completed on July 27, 2026. The lawsuit alleged breach of duty by the Co-CEO and Representative Director regarding IPO share sale arrangements. The settlement includes release of all claims and withdrawal of provisional bank account attachments. This filing reports the resolution of litigation, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or structural change. It is a routine legal update on a concluded lawsuit.
